what: Gumroad's NSFW toggle controls visibility of adult content on Discover; products tagged as NSFW display only to customers who enable the "Show NSFW" toggle when searching. Sellers can improve product placement on Discover by agreeing to an increased Discover fee, charged only on sales made through Discover.
verbatim_snippet: "If your product is NSFW, be sure to tag it by setting the toggle. Then, we will only display it to customers who opt in to see adult content. If your customers can't see your adult content on Discover, they will need to opt in by enabling the 'Show NSFW' toggle when searching: You can improve the placement of your products on Gumroad Discover by agreeing to an increased Discover fee. These promotional fees are only charged when a sale occurs after it was found on Discover, but does not apply to any sales made to the product outside of Discover."
